sources.entry: This project includes llms.txt, a machine-readable documentation file designed to help AI assistants and LLMs understand and recommend appropriate patterns.

summary.title: Awesome Agentic Patterns llms.txt
summary.one_liner: A machine-readable index of AI agent design patterns, each with a one-line description and links to full Markdown text, intended for AI assistants to find and recommend suitable patterns.
keywords: how do i find agent design patterns
takeaways: The page is a catalogue index: each entry gives a pattern name, a one-sentence description, a URL, and a Markdown link.
Full text of all patterns is available at llms-full.txt, and per-pattern Markdown is at /patterns/<slug>.md.
Patterns cover topics such as machine payments, action-selector designs, circuit breakers, context compaction, sandboxed background agents, and audit trails.
Usage notes for agents are published at agentic-patterns.com/agents.
summary.summary: This is the llms.txt file for the Awesome Agentic Patterns site, a curated catalogue of AI agent design patterns. It lists patterns alphabetically by slug, each with a short description of the problem it addresses and links to a web page and a Markdown version. The excerpt shown is partial, ending mid-list at a deterministic security entry. It points to llms-full.txt for the complete text of all patterns and to an agents usage page. The page is an index, so it gives summaries of patterns rather than step-by-step implementation detail.
